parameters.name: HostIp
parameters.description: Query by instance host IP address.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description:
Instance ID.

This parameter is used to query multiple instances simultaneously. Separate instance IDs with English commas (,), and up to 100 IDs are supported. The input format is: `["instance ID 1","instance ID 2"]`.

> When both **InstanceIds** and **instanceId** are provided, the value of **InstanceIds** takes precedence.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number.

Page starts from page 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: PublicIp
parameters.description: Query by instance public IP address.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Instance status. Valid values:  

- **Pending**: Creation in progress.  
- **Running**: Running.  
- **Starting**: Starting.  
- **Stopping**: Pausing.  
- **Stopped**: Paused.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: Query by specified tag. The input format is: `{"TagKey":"TagValue"}`.
